narrative.coaching_note: Lávese las manos o use alcohol gel después de tocar la zona del paciente antes de tocar algo fuera de esa zona. Usted tocó bed rail A con bare hand a los 0.5 segundos y después tocó call button a los 3.4 segundos, y la contaminación pasó de bare hand a call button y a phone. Usted perdió el Momento 5 a los 5.8 segundos después de tocar call button y otra vez a los 18.7 segundos con gloved hand. Usted se puso los guantes a los 10.9 segundos sin hacer higiene de manos antes, y después tocó phone con gloved hand a los 19.3 segundos, que está fuera de la zona del paciente. La próxima vez, haga higiene de manos antes de ponerse los guantes y quítese los guantes antes de tocar phone.
narrative.audit_summary: Staged clip with C. auris source bed rail A. Bare hand contacted bed rail A at 0.5 s, call button at 3.4 s, phone at 6.6 s; transfers bed rail A to bare hand at 0.5 s, bare hand to call button at 3.4 s and to phone at 6.6 s, plus bed rail A to gloved hand at 11.1 s. Hand hygiene compliance 0/2 overall; Moment 5 0/2, Moments 1, 2, 4 0 opportunities, with missed Moment 5 at 5.8 s (bare hand) and 18.7 s (gloved hand). No hygiene events recorded. Glove issues included no hygiene before don at 10.9 s and gloved contact with healthcare-area phone at 19.3 s. Contaminated at end: bare hand, gloved hand, bed rail A, call button, phone. Disinfect bed rail A, call button, phone using an EPA List P registered disinfectant effective against Candida auris; routine quaternary ammonium products are not reliable.
narrative.top_fix: The highest-impact single change in this clip was hand hygiene for Moment 5 at 5.8 seconds.
